record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:175 — Confirm (and the Stripe/PayPal payment-success handlers) rebuild destinationCalendar from only booking.destinationCalendar (the first host), so collective events that need confirmation or payment still create a calendar event for only one host.

adjudication.rationale: In confirm.handler.ts the rebuilt CalendarEvent sets `destinationCalendar` to either `[booking.destinationCalendar]` or `[user.destinationCalendar]` (never adding other hosts’ destination calendars). The Stripe/PayPal payment-success flows shown do the same via `selectedDestinationCalendar = booking.destinationCalendar || user.destinationCalendar` and then `destinationCalendar: selectedDestinationCalendar ? [selectedDestinationCalendar] : []`. Meanwhile, the diff explicitly introduces multi-calendar support for collective team events in handleNewBooking.ts by collecting `teamDestinationCalendars` and doing `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, and EventManager now iterates `event.destinationCalendar` to create events per destination. These confirm/payment handlers therefore lose the extra calendars and will only create a calendar event for one destination in collective flows that defer event creation until confirmation/payment.
